definition: Sensor values have consistent drift upwards or downwards. Typically due to internal sensor component drift or biofouling of optical or membrane sensors
corrections: Where applicable, fDOM or Turbidity data can be corrected using exponential or linear fits. OMIT data points where slope is excessive

definition: Water is likely frozen near sensor heads and is thus influencing sensor values
corrections: OMIT data if noise is excessive

definition: Sensor values are higher or lower than acceptable seasonal range.
corrections: OMIT data if noise is excessive

definition: Sensor values are higher or lower than acceptable sensor specification  range.
Sensor values have consistent drift upwards or downwards. Typically due to internal sensor component drift or biofouling of optical or membrane sensors
corrections: Can be corrected with smoothing or averaging

definition: Sensor issues resulting in poor data quality, typically related to software or deployment issues. Reference field notes prior to applying flag
Sensor values occurred during site visit and should be flagged due to technician handling the sensor improperly
corrections: Omit data if erroneous otherwise can be kept

definition: Sensor values have high slope that is incosistent with other parameters or nearby sites.
corrections: OMIT data if noise is excessive, average if noise is small

definition: Sensor was likely buried by sediment and values are likely erronous
Sonde was recording/transmitting values while not in deployment
Sonde was recording/transmitting values while sensor was unsubmerged from water
Sensor values have high variability that is incosistent with other parameters or nearby sites. Typically due to environmental conditions or wiper ineffectiveness
corrections: Can be corrected with smoothing or averaging

definition: Sensor values occurred during site visit and should be flagged due to technician handling the sensor improperly
corrections: Omit data if erroneous otherwise can be kept

definition: Values were affected by poor/incorrect calibration and should be corrected later on
corrections: Where applicable, calibrations can be corrected using calibration information. If correction is unsuccessful but data is within acceptable error, flag but do not omit.  If correction is unsuccessful or calibration information is unavailable and data is outside of acceptable error, OMIT

definition: Values were affected by a faulty wiper stopping in front of the sensor causing sensor noise
corrections: Can be corrected with smoothing or averaging

definition: Sonde and vulink  improperly merging barometric pressure resulting in incorrect depth (large daily fluctuations)
Depth trend is correct but very noisy due to turbulent flows, should be averaged later on
corrections: Can be corrected with smoothing or averaging

definition: DO interference. Typically at lower ranges and less mixed sites
corrections: Can be corrected with smoothing or averaging
